mapper.sql: Post.Id, Post.BoardId, Post.UserId, Post.AnonymousIdentityId, Post.AnonymousName, Post.AnonymousAvatar, Post.AnonymousColor, Post.Title, Post.Content, Post.ContentText, Post.Images, Post.ViewCount, Post.ReplyCount, Post.LikeCount, Post.FavoriteCount, Post.ShareCount, Post.ReportCount, Post.HotScore, Post.IsTop, Post.IsEssence, Post.Status, Post.IpHash, Post.DeviceHash, Post.CreatedAt, Post.UpdatedAt, Post.Deleted, Board.Name as boardname, Board.Code as boardcode
mapper.select:
select
from Post left join Board on Board.Id = Post.BoardId where Post.Deleted = 0 and Post.Status = 1 order by Post.HotScore desc, Post.CreatedAt desc limit #{limit}

select
from Post left join Board on Board.Id = Post.BoardId where Post.Id = #{id} and Post.Deleted = 0

select Comment.Id, Comment.PostId, Comment.UserId, Comment.RootId, Comment.ParentId, Comment.ReplyUserId, Comment.AnonymousIdentityId, Comment.AnonymousName, Comment.Content, Comment.LikeCount, Comment.ReplyCount, Comment.Status, Comment.CreatedAt, ru.Nickname as replyusername from Comment left join User ru on ru.Id = Comment.ReplyUserId and ru.Deleted = 0 where Comment.PostId = #{postId} and Comment.Status = 1 order by Comment.CreatedAt asc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from Comment where PostId = #{postId} and Status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into Post(Id, BoardId, UserId, AnonymousIdentityId, AnonymousName, AnonymousAvatar, AnonymousColor, Title, Content, ContentText, Images, ViewCount, ReplyCount, LikeCount, FavoriteCount, ShareCount, ReportCount, HotScore, IsTop, IsEssence, Status, IpHash, DeviceHash, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, Deleted) values (#{id}, #{boardid}, #{userid}, #{anonymousidentityid}, #{anonymousname}, #{anonymousavatar}, #{anonymouscolor}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contenttext}, #{images}, #{viewcount}, #{replycount}, #{likecount}, #{favoritecount}, #{sharecount}, #{reportcount}, #{hotscore}, #{istop}, #{isessence}, #{status}, #{iphash}, #{devicehash}, #{createdat}, #{updatedat}, #{deleted})

insert into Comment(Id, PostId, UserId, RootId, ParentId, ReplyUserId, AnonymousIdentityId, AnonymousName, Content, LikeCount, ReplyCount, Status, CreatedAt) values (#{id}, #{postid}, #{userid}, #{rootid}, #{parentid}, #{replyuserid}, #{anonymousidentityid}, #{anonymousname}, #{content}, #{likecount}, #{replycount}, #{status}, #{createdat})
mapper.select: select Id, Name, Code, Icon, Description, SortOrder, PostCount, FollowCount, Status, ShowOnHome, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt from Board where Status = 1 order by SortOrder desc, Id asc
select Id, Name, Code, Icon, Description, SortOrder, PostCount, FollowCount, Status, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt from Board where Code = #{code}
select Id, UserId, Type, SourceUserId, TargetId, Content, IsRead, CreatedAt from Notification where UserId = #{userId} order by CreatedAt desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from Notification where UserId = #{userId} and IsRead = 0

select Id, UserId, Type, SourceUserId, TargetId, Content, IsRead, CreatedAt from Notification where Type = 1 and (UserId = #{me} or SourceUserId = #{me}) and SourceUserId is not null and SourceUserId <> 0 order by CreatedAt desc

select Id, UserId, Type, SourceUserId, TargetId, Content, IsRead, CreatedAt from Notification where Type = 1 and ((UserId = #{me} and SourceUserId = #{other}) or (UserId = #{other} and SourceUserId = #{me})) order by CreatedAt asc limit 200
select UserId from Post where Id = #{id} and Deleted = 0
mapper.update: update Post set Deleted = 1, UpdatedAt = NOW() where Id = #{id}
mapper.select: select UserId from Comment where Id = #{id} and Status = 1

select
from Post left join Board on Board.Id = Post.BoardId where Post.Deleted = 0 and Post.UserId = #{userId} order by Post.CreatedAt desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from Post where Deleted = 0 and UserId = #{userId}

select Comment.Id as id, Comment.PostId as postId, Comment.Content as content, Comment.LikeCount as likeCount, Comment.CreatedAt as createdAt, Post.Title as postTitle from Comment left join Post on Post.Id = Comment.PostId where Comment.UserId = #{userId} and Comment.Status = 1 order by Comment.CreatedAt desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from Comment where UserId = #{userId} and Status = 1
select ( (select coalesce(sum(LikeCount), 0) from Post where UserId = #{userId} and Deleted = 0) + (select coalesce(sum(LikeCount), 0) from Comment where UserId = #{userId} and Status = 1) )

select 'post' as type, Id as id, Title as title, LikeCount as likeCount, CreatedAt as createdAt, Id as postId from Post where UserId = #{userId} and Deleted = 0 and LikeCount > 0 union all select 'comment' as type, Comment.Id as id, Comment.Content as title, Comment.LikeCount as likeCount, Comment.CreatedAt as createdAt, Comment.PostId as postId from Comment where Comment.UserId = #{userId} and Comment.Status = 1 and Comment.LikeCount > 0 order by likeCount desc, createdAt desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: insert into Notification(Id, UserId, Type, SourceUserId, TargetId, Content, IsRead, CreatedAt) values (#{id}, #{userid}, #{type}, #{sourceuserid}, #{targetid}, #{content}, #{isread}, #{createdat})
mapper.select: select count(1) from Post where Deleted = 0 and Status = 1
select count(1) from Comment where Status = 1
select count(1) from User where Deleted = 0
select count(1) from Post where Deleted = 0 and Status = 1 and CreatedAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
select Id as id, Nickname as nickname from User where Deleted = 0 and Status = 1 order by LastLoginAt desc, CreatedAt desc limit #{limit}
